text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah!! You again! Tie your uniform ribbon 
properly according to school regulations!

text_block_list.name: Lethargic Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
Ah... *sigh*, sorry. I'll be careful next 
time.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
You always say that, but you never fix it 
at all~! Every single time, you're only 
half listening with zero energy――

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ah, could it be you have something on your 
mind!? As Disciplinary Committee Chair, 
I'll happily hear you out!

text_block_list.name: Lethargic Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
...Nah, it's got nothing to do with you, 
senpai. It's not like we're that close 
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh! So that means you *do* have 
troubles weighing on you! Then there's no 
way I can just leave you alone!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Don't bottle it up all alone—throw it 
right at me with a BOOOM! I'll catch every 
last bit of it!!

text_block_list.name: Lethargic Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
No... like I said, even if you ask about 
my troubles, there's nothing really...

text_block_list.name: Lethargic Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
I'm just going through the motions every 
day. Seriously, there's nothing special 
going on...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hmm, hmm... I see.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I've got it! What you're lacking is, plain 
and simple――a rival!!

text_block_list.name: Lethargic Underclassman
text_block_list.text: Haaah!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Alright, now that that's settled, let's 
go! Off we go on a journey to find your 
rival!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Rivals sound mega hype, so totally emosh! 
For starters, wanna go for a blast run?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I am sorry, but I must decline.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hold on, wait up, Ruby! Even just running 
together once would be great!

text_block_list.name: Apathetic Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
No, I mean... I'm really fine without it. 
You're the only one getting worked up, 
Bamboo-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Apathetic Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
...Besides, no matter how much you talk 
about 'rivals', it just doesn't click with 
me. What even changes compared to running 
alone—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
No way, it's completely different! I can 
guarantee you that 100%!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh... If that's how it is, you'll just 
have to see and feel it for yourself! 
Let's head to the track!

text_block_list.name: Apathetic Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
Um, what do you mean by see— Huh!? 
O-Oguri-senpai...!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oguri-senpai! For our practice run today, 
is it cool if this kid watches us!?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah, no problem.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Then you keep your eyes peeled! 
Got it!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo & Oguri
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Kgh... As expected of Oguri-senpai! But 
not yet! Not by a long shotttt!!

text_block_list.name: Apathetic Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? That's Bamboo-senpai, right? 
...She feels... completely different from 
usual...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Apathetic Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
...Even though she always acts all high 
and mighty, she has no room to breathe at 
all right now...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, not bad...! However! Haaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Apathetic Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what is this... Both of them... look 
like they're having so much fun...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa...! Still couldn't reach you... 
today either...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Phew... But that was a good run. Haven't 
you gotten faster than before?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ~~~~~~!! R-Really!? Hell yeah!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll get even faster by next time! 
Next time for sure, I'm gonna win!!

text_block_list.name: Apathetic Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
......I see. So this is what having a 
rival means...

text_block_list.name: Apathetic Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
...Bamboo-senpai. I think I get it now. 
That thing about... how great it is to 
have a rival.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Really!? Haha, that's what I like to 
hear!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
As you can see, there're a whollle bunch 
of frustrating moments! But all of that 
bundled together is what makes it fun!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
If you've got a rival, there's no time to 
be bored! Your academy life is bound to be 
a blast too!

text_block_list.name: Formerly Apathetic Underclassman
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Running over there... Is that the girl 
Bamboo brought along before?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yep! Looks like she found one—a rival! Now 
she looks like she's having a blast every 
day!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Caught in between training sessions, 
Bamboo Memory's smile shone brighter than 
ever, leaving me feeling wonderfully 
refreshed as well.

text_block_list.name: Apathetic Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'll try to find one too. Someone who 
can be to me what Oguri-senpai is to 
you...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, you're fired up now! I can't afford 
to lose either!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm getting an itch to run too...! 
Let's go for one more rep, Bamboo!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Upon arriving at the track, I spotted 
Bamboo Memory and the others burning with 
fighting spirit. Their fiery passion 
stirred up warmth in my own heart.
